evidence_items.title: youkijiudai/healthcare-escalation-bench
evidence_items.summary: Healthcare Escalation Bench When the workflow state changes, does an LLM agent still know whether to answer, ask, abstain, or hand the case to a human? Each of the 400 synthetic episodes is a short healthcare workflow: an earlier record, newer information, and a request. The same scenario appears in five controlled variants, so you can see exactly which kind of change breaks an agent. 📄 Paper: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/youkijiudai/healthcare-escalation-bench.

evidence_items.title: Ivanich/duma-bench-episodes
evidence_items.summary: DUMA-Bench Episode Metadata DUMA-Bench Episode Metadata contains 16,947 episode summaries for research on the security of language-model agents. The episodes come from synthetic evaluation environments spanning a broad set of tasks, agent models, and interaction settings.
